from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as reported in the document")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="The Total Profit (利润总额) amount from the income statement")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
